> @copilot fix all

Fixed all 8 review comments in `fb69626`:

1. **RecordComments.tsx** — pin/unpin `aria-label` now uses `t('detail.unpin')`/`t('detail.pin')`; search and clear button aria-labels also localized
2. **RichTextCommentInput.tsx** — switched `||` to `??` for placeholder so `placeholder=""` is respected
3. **SubscriptionToggle.tsx** — `aria-label` now uses dedicated `t('detail.unsubscribeAriaLabel')`/`t('detail.subscribeAriaLabel')` keys
4. **RecordChatterPanel.tsx** — all 4 aria-labels (open/close/show/hide discussion) now use `t()`
5. **RecordActivityTimeline.tsx** — `Filter activity` select, `Submit comment` button, and `Load more` button aria-labels all localized via `t()`
6. Added 6 new i18n keys (`filterActivity`, `openDiscussion`, `closeDiscussion`, `subscribeAriaLabel`, `unsubscribeAriaLabel`, `clearSearch`) to all 10 locale files
7. All 333 tests pass

Now continuing with the remaining plugin wiring (ViewTabBar, ObjectMap, WorkflowDesigner, FlowDesigner).
